protocol.common_quality_floor: Identical Q0 for every acquisition arm: valid expert supervision, complete episodes, aligned actions and observations, legal train split and source-family deduplication. agent_targeted uses Q0 only; fdas additionally applies Qt to the same target acquisition route and pool.
protocol.metric: Native task success rate; macro average across the prespecified tasks only after all required cells are available. Development results and final confirmation remain separate.
protocol.cost_accounting: This selection-increment matrix is an equal-accepted-data draft, not equal compute. Record the same target-pool identity for the agent_targeted/FDAS contrast; charge failed attempts, rejected samples, conversion, selection and actual training. Shared acquisition is accounted once and explicitly attributed, never duplicated into independent generation or free filtering.
protocol.exclusion_rules: Task list is provisional until native capability, resources and measured runtime are audited. Freeze final selection before held-out search. Never drop failed trials post hoc; retain missing cells and explanations. No best-seed selection. fixed_official means independently trained on official data, not multiple seed labels for one published policy; released-checkpoint reproduction is a separate calibration track.
